full_prompt_en: A square painterly architectural image shows a teal-blue gabled house behind a dense front garden on a quiet street. The house sits across the center, its dark charcoal roof forming steep triangles against a pale blue-gray sky. A high central gable contains small upper windows, while a lower wing extends to the left with a single dormer set into the roof. At ground level, a dark arched entry opens above pale steps that rise from a straight front walk. Multi-pane windows on either side carry warm reflections and darker interiors. Low stone retaining walls and black metal fencing divide the planted beds from the sidewalk along the bottom edge. Layered grasses, shrubs and small blossoms fill the beds in dusty green, muted gold and touches of pink. On the left, a tall tree spreads fine yellow leaves into the upper corner; on the right, a shorter yellow-orange tree partly veils the facade. Soft distant foliage closes the view behind the roof, while a few tiny dark birds cross the open sky. The rendering mixes clear structural edges with lightly brushed leaves and mottled surfaces, so the building feels solid within a gentle illustrative atmosphere. Daylight is diffuse and slightly warm, brightening the yellow foliage and pale stone while leaving the entry, roof and plant depths cool and dark. There are no people or readable signs. The overall composition is calm and welcoming, balancing the house's crisp teal geometry with loose autumn planting and generous pale sky.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、带绘画感的建筑画面呈现一幢青蓝色尖顶住宅，立在安静街道旁浓密的前花园后。房子横跨中央，深炭色屋顶在浅蓝灰天空前形成陡峭三角形。高耸的中央山墙有上层小窗，较低的侧翼向左延伸，屋顶上嵌着一处老虎窗。底层，一道深色拱形入口位于浅色台阶上方，台阶从笔直的前方步道升起。两侧多格窗映着暖色反光，也显出更暗的室内。低矮石砌挡墙与黑色金属栅栏把花床同下缘的人行道隔开。层叠草丛、灌木和小花以灰绿、低调金色与少量粉色填满花床。左边，一棵高树把细碎黄叶伸入上角；右边，一棵较矮的黄橙色树部分遮住立面。柔软的远景树丛收住屋顶后的视线，几只细小深色鸟掠过开阔天空。渲染把清晰的结构边缘与轻刷的叶片、斑驳表面结合，使建筑在温和插画气氛中保持稳固。日光漫射且稍暖，照亮黄色树叶和浅色石头，入口、屋顶与植物深处则保留冷暗。画面没有人物或可读标识。整体构图平静而亲切，以住宅利落的青蓝几何形平衡松散秋季植物与宽裕浅色天空。
style_prompt_en: A soft painterly rendering combines clear geometric boundaries with loose, feathery organic marks. Muted teal and blue-gray form the cool base, while buttery yellow, ochre and a few pale pink accents add warmth in small clustered areas. Surface color is gently mottled rather than perfectly flat, with fine grain and lightly brushed transitions visible in broad planes. Diffuse daylight keeps highlights open and shadows transparent, though a few charcoal passages create firm anchors. Vertical and triangular rhythms organize the middle of the frame while irregular soft clusters spread around them. A broad pale upper field gives the denser lower detail room to breathe. The result feels calm, airy and approachable, with structure and softness held in balance.
style_prompt_zh: 柔和绘画式渲染把清晰几何边界与松散、羽毛般的有机笔痕结合。低调青蓝与蓝灰构成冷色底，奶油黄、赭色及少量浅粉重音在小块聚集区域注入温暖。表面颜色轻微斑驳，而非完美平涂；大色面可见细颗粒和轻刷过渡。漫射日光让高光开敞、阴影透明，少量炭黑区域则提供坚实锚点。竖向与三角形节奏组织画面中部，不规则柔软簇群在周围展开。宽阔浅色上部让更密的下部细节得以呼吸。整体平静、通透而亲切，结构感与柔软感保持平衡。
theme_en: A teal blue gabled house behind a layered garden in soft autumn light
theme_zh: 柔和秋光中，青蓝色尖顶住宅立在层叠花园后
name: Emily Henderson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
